fields.title: Introduce Yourself
fields.prompt_text: Introduce yourself to a new classmate. Say your name, where you are from, your favorite hobby, and why you want to learn English.

fields.title: My Daily Morning Routine
fields.prompt_text: Describe what you usually do in the morning from the moment you wake up until you start work or study.

fields.title: Favorite Foods
fields.prompt_text: Talk about two of your favorite foods. Describe what they taste like and when you like to eat them.

fields.title: A Memorable Weekend Trip
fields.prompt_text: Tell a short story about a trip or weekend outing you took recently. Use past tense verbs to explain where you went and what happened.

fields.title: Describing Your Hometown
fields.prompt_text: Describe the town or city where you grew up. Mention the weather, the people, and what visitors should see.

fields.title: Future Plans and Goals
fields.prompt_text: Explain what you are planning to achieve over the next six months in your studies or personal life.

fields.title: Remote Work vs Office Work
fields.prompt_text: Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of working remotely compared to working in a traditional office. Conclude with your personal preference.

fields.title: Handling a Difficult Customer or Situation
fields.prompt_text: Describe a situation where you faced an unexpected challenge or misunderstanding. How did you resolve it?

fields.title: Impact of Social Media on Friendships
fields.prompt_text: Share your perspective on whether social media has made people feel more connected or more isolated. Give specific examples.

fields.title: Artificial Intelligence in Everyday Life
fields.prompt_text: Analyze how artificial intelligence is transforming education and modern jobs. Weigh the efficiency benefits against ethical concerns.

fields.title: Urban Sustainability and Green Cities
fields.prompt_text: Propose three pragmatic initiatives that municipal governments should implement to reduce carbon emissions and improve urban living conditions.

fields.title: Overcoming Professional Adversity
fields.prompt_text: Reflect on a setback you experienced. Discuss how resilience and emotional intelligence enabled you to rebound and grow.

fields.title: The Economics of Higher Education
fields.prompt_text: Critique the contemporary model of higher education financing. To what extent should tertiary education be publicly funded, and what are the macroeconomic ramifications?

fields.title: Algorithmic Bias and Digital Sovereignty
fields.prompt_text: Examine the tension between corporate proprietary algorithmic governance and personal data autonomy. Deliver a structured argument proposing an international regulatory framework.

fields.title: Philosophical Inquiry: Determinism vs Agency
fields.prompt_text: Elucidate the philosophical debate between strict causal determinism and moral agency in modern neuroscience. Synthesize nuanced viewpoints with rhetorical clarity.

Welcome to our colloquium. Today we are critically examining autonomous generative systems. In your assessment, who should bear legal and moral accountability when an AI agent outputs harmful misinformation or infringes copyright?

Well, this is a real issue in nowadays because every company is using AI in their workflow. So the accountability matters in this scenario and it matters even more nowadays. So I, in my opinion, the person who's in charge of developing that technology using AI, a person or a person who is supervising AI agents' output should be the one that should be accountable for the outcomes.

Fascinating perspective; placing the burden directly on the developers and human supervisors certainly grounds liability in traditional frameworks. However, when these neural networks operate as autonomous black boxes—learning and adapting far beyond their initial programming—do you not think it becomes nearly impossible to trace a harmful output back to a single human decision? How would you propose holding a supervisor accountable for an emergent behavior they could neither predict nor fully understand?
